data_fields.name: practice_gate_per_level
data_fields.donor_constant: level * level * 20 (advance when counter reaches it)

data_fields.name: qualifying_hit_min_base_damage
data_fields.donor_constant: base damage must be more than 1 to train

data_fields.name: slot_cost_weapon_step
data_fields.donor_constant: current level (1 to basic, 2 to skilled, 3 to expert)

best_idea: A per-skill practice counter that never resets and is gated by level squared, with the spend of a separate budget (slots) and only a small to-hit and damage ladder per level, so the fight writes one number per hit and the player chooses when to raise it.
decision_why: Frankendom's weapon skills need a visible, server-replayable progression: one counter per hit, a level-squared gate and a small ladder fit a fast duel. Adapt: keep the counter, gate, player-chosen advance and ladders; replace the slot budget with Frankendom's single XP ledger; show every term on the phone. Reject the donor's character-level slot income as the only budget.
acceptance: Server test with a fixed seed: a fighter with 2 slots gets 20 qualifying hits, enhances unskilled to basic and keeps 1 slot; a hit with base damage 1 adds no practice; on the same target the to-hit total rises by 0 at basic and by +3 at expert.
